blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has officially renewed the suspension of excise taxes on liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) and kerosene following President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s order for a second round of tax relief. The second round of the suspension was mandated through Executive Order No. 125, issued on Sept. 25, and subsequently implemented by the BIR through Revenue Memorandum Circular No. 100-2026. Both issuances contain the same provisions as the first round of the tax suspension.
